articles.summary: - Late-breaking Phase 3 AZURE-1 and longer-term brelovitug efficacy, safety, and deepening treatment response data highlighted across a broad HDV population, including patients with cirrhosis - Additional Phase 2b VISTAS study analyses reinforce the efficacy and safety profiles of volixibat in PSC patients across varying baseline levels of itch severity, without worsening IBD activity - New clinical and real-world evidence provides insights into LIVMARLI® (maralixibat) treatment outcomes and the broader burden of cholestatic pruritus Mirum Pharmaceuticals, Inc. (Nasdaq: MIRM), a leading rare disease company, today announced that data from its rare liver disease portfolio will be presented at the American Association for the Study of Liver Diseases’ (AASLD) The Liver Meeting® 2026, taking place November 5-9, 2026, in Denver, Colorado.
